answer: Continuous liveness attestation: each identity must answer randomized challenges within a short pulse window, and missed replies decay its score below the registration threshold. The enforcement rule requires every device to sustain round-the-clock responsiveness across a rolling horizon, so spoofed duplicates must each hold genuine idle hardware and bandwidth perpetually. Any single operator faking N identities then pays N times the real device and uptime cost, and one shared responder creates a detectable ripple of correlated timing that exposes the whole cluster.
